Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Only those MSME registered service providers, who are duly authorized/ Channel partners by/of OEM i.e. CISCO are exempted from submission of E MD. All other MSME registered bidders/service provider is required to submit EMD as prescribe d in the bid document, failing which the bid will be rejected outrightly . 8. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 9. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
